newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: BOURSE INFORMS ON W.DE BROE HERMIS ACQUISITION.
newsitem.headline: BOURSE INFORMS ON W.DE BROE HERMIS ACQUISITION.

text.p: The Lithuanian stock exchange said on Tuesday that Lithuania's central bank had allowed Williams de Broe to acquire over 10 percent in Hermis Bank.

"According to the resolution...of the Bank of Lithuania, Williams de Broe is entitled to acquire 10.4 percent of Hermis Bank's authorised capital and to manage 12.1 percent of the block of charge with voting rights," the bourse said.
Hermis Bank said earlier that it had successfully distributed its new share issue, which has a face value of 23 million litas.
Hermis signed an agreement with Williams de Broe to distribute shares of the new issue, with a face value of 8.1 million litas, as global depository receipts.
Hermis Bank's total share capital will stand at 90 million litas after the share capital boost.
